statedLimitations: GOVERNED EVIDENCE IS EMPTY. Every §262 execution transmits zero governed records, so Expert may cite nothing. This is the fail-closed choice, not an oversight, and it means §262 has NOT exercised the governed-citation path at all.

THE DETERMINISTIC ANALYSIS IS RUN A SECOND TIME. The server runs its own classify for Expert's input rather than reading the client-supplied snapshot the user is looking at. That is what makes the premises server-owned, and it means Expert may reason from a deterministic analysis that differs from the one displayed if the two runs diverge. Reconciling the two is a later-slice product question.

ANALYSIS_UNRESOLVED COVERS TWO DIFFERENT SHAPES. A contained declaration refusal with an admitted posture (case F) and a whole-output refusal with preserved truth (case G) both derive to ANALYSIS_UNRESOLVED, because §252 gives PRESERVE_UNRESOLVED precedence. They remain distinguishable on the execution record, not in the product state.
